Meet the 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT Trail Boss, a white truck built to handle serious work and weekend adventures with equal capability.- Front bucket seats with center console- Leather-appointed front seat trim- Bose premium sound system with SiriusXM- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto- Dual-zone automatic climate control with heated steering wheel- 12.3" digital reconfigurable display- Hitch guidance with hitch view and trailering app- Integrated trailer brake controller- Lane keep assist with lane departure warning- Automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection- Off-road assist steps- Chevytec spray-on bedliner with wheel house liners- 20" high gloss black painted aluminum wheels- LED fog lamps and cargo area lighting- 4-wheel independent suspension with hill descent controlThe heart of this Silverado is the EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine, which delivers 355 horsepower and 383 lb-ft of torque. This engine features dynamic fuel management technology that operates in 17 different patterns between 2 and 8 cylinders, adjusting power delivery based on your driving needs. Paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability, this truck provides the performance and efficiency you need for both highway cruising and challenging terrain.This Trail Boss package comes equipped with specialized off-road features designed for adventure. The hill descent control helps you navigate steep descents with confidence, while the integrated trailer brake controller and hitch guidance system make towing straightforward and safe. The trailering app provides real-time monitoring of your connected trailer, giving you complete control and visibility.Inside, you'll find a driver-focused cabin with front bucket seats wrapped in leather and a heated steering wheel for comfort in any season. The Bose premium sound system combined with SiriusXM satellite radio keeps you entertained throughout your journey. Dual-zone automatic climate control ensures both driver and passenger stay comfortable, while the Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you connected with smartphone compatibility.The exterior reflects the truck's commanding Trail Boss identity with 20" high gloss black aluminum wheels, LED fog lamps, black nameplate badging, and a sleek spray-on bedliner for durability. Performance red recovery hooks stand ready when you need them, while the power sliding rear window with defogger adds practicality to your daily driving.Safety technology is integrated throughout, including automatic emergency braking with pedestrian detection, lane keep assist with lane departure warning, and a 360-degree camera system. The truck achieves 16 MPG city and 19 MPG highway, making it practical for both work and lifestyle use.
